methods: all29 original frozen settings without ranking-based selection
source_training_mean: mean of all1500 source training responses per gene, computed float64, subtracted from both observed and frozen predicted target vectors
same_drug_source_reference: original same_drug_dose_mean frozen prediction, same query/gene/fold, subtracted from both sides; no cross-LOCO subtraction
new_descriptive_endpoint: per-condition Spearman across the same3000 genes after each transform; all valid and NA counts
error_invariance: complete per-query MAE/RMSE unchanged after either shared subtraction; arithmetic identity, not extra robustness evidence
gene_order_invariance: complete per-gene cross-query tied ranks unchanged after source_training_mean subtraction; implies Spearman/pair order identity also on restricted subset; not a new endpoint
replicate_diagnostic: log2((measurement normalized_mean+1)/(measurement control_B_mean+1)), compare rep1 and rep2 within each target atom and fold gene panel
replicate_precision: read original frozen measurement-mean cache; disclose its dtypes, do not represent as a new full-raw reconstruction
replicate_units: two separately treated biological replicate wells, with per-replicate matched B controls; drugs can share reference controls, three cell lines belong to one study
selection: no selection or exclusion using test response magnitude, residual metrics or observed replicate agreement
